--- a/moto/cognitoidp/responses.py
+++ b/moto/cognitoidp/responses.py
@@ -28,6 +28,59 @@
     @property
     def backend(self) -> CognitoIdpBackend:
         return cognitoidp_backends[self.current_account][self.region]
+        
+    def call_action(self) -> TYPE_RESPONSE:
+        """
+        Override the call_action method to bypass authentication for public Cognito operations.
+        """
+        headers = self.response_headers
+        action = camelcase_to_underscores(self._get_action())
+        
+        # List of public operations that should not require authentication
+        public_operations = [
+            "forgot_password",
+            "get_user",
+            "confirm_sign_up",
+            "initiate_auth",
+            "respond_to_auth_challenge",
+            "confirm_forgot_password",
+            "sign_up"
+        ]
+        
+        # Skip authentication for public operations
+        if action not in public_operations:
+            try:
+                self._authenticate_and_authorize_normal_action()
+            except HTTPException as http_error:
+                response = http_error.description, dict(status=http_error.code)
+                status, headers, body = self._transform_response(headers, response)
+                headers, body = self._enrich_response(headers, body)
+                return status, headers, body
+        
+        method_names = method_names_from_class(self.__class__)
+        
+        if action in method_names:
+            method = getattr(self, action)
+            try:
+                response = method()
+            except HTTPException as http_error:
+                response_headers = dict(http_error.get_headers() or [])
+                response_headers["status"] = http_error.code
+                response = http_error.description, response_headers
+                
+            if isinstance(response, str):
+                status = 200
+                body = response
+            else:
+                status, headers, body = self._transform_response(headers, response)
+                
+            headers, body = self._enrich_response(headers, body)
+            return status, headers, body
+            
+        if not action:
+            return 404, headers, ""
+            
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"The {action} action has not been implemented")
